The same profile drove 4 closed cases in August-September that analysts confirmed as undocumented fraud. Found by following FROM_DEVICE from the flagged transaction to the profile and back out to every other card on it.

sar.narrative: This report concerns internal case AC-HHG-014, opened 2016-11-22, describing an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern identified as an anonymous-proxy device ring. The subject is customer C13487 and mastercard debit card C13487-K1, which conducted two online purchases from the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080, a profile that on the current wave also appears on 27 other cards, 19 of which were already active on it before this case opened. On 2016-11-15 at 20:30 the card made an online purchase of $112.37 from this device, and on 2016-11-22 at 16:11 the card made a second online purchase of $74.96, product code C, billing region 191.0, again from the same device, marked New for the account; both transactions occurred before the case was opened and together total $187.33 in exposure. The device profile is routed through IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS, and following the profile from the flagged transaction out to the other cards sharing it showed the same profile behind four closed cases, CC-2649, CC-3035, CC-2971 and CC-2985, opened in August and September 2016, all of which analysts confirmed as fraud tied to the identical undocumented ring pattern. As of the case opening the card had 71 prior transactions with a median amount of $55.92 and a maximum of $225.94, spread mainly across two billing regions (191.0 and 272.0); the two device profiles previously seen on the card were this same SM-G935F profile, first used 2016-11-15, and a distinct Windows 10 edge browser profile first seen 2016-10-02, so the sudden linkage of the card's device to a proxy-routed profile shared by dozens of other cards in the same short window is inconsistent with the card's own device history and points to coordinated abuse rather than isolated card use. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card; closed cases CC-2649, CC-3035, CC-2971 and CC-2985 on the same device profile or connected cards were confirmed fraud with reports filed. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. A case has been opened and monitoring of the connected cards sharing this device profile has been put in place, and the matter has been escalated to an analyst to review the wider wave of cards on this profile; a block of card C13487-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and the filing of this report is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering total suspicious activity of $187.33.
